يقتضبوا (form VIII)
# يَقْتَضِبُوا (yaqtaḍibū) /jaq.ta.dˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
# يُقْتَضَبُوا (yuqtaḍabū) /juq.ta.dˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَضَبَ (iqtaḍaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
